question: Where can I get the routes or service areas of district heating and cooling networks in Spain, with operator, capacity and heat source?

answer.summary: No open file with routes or service areas of Spanish district heating and cooling networks was found. Best source: the ADHAC census (industry association, with IDAE), a 2025 PDF list of 585 networks with municipality, supply type and fuels, but no operator, MW or coordinates; MW exist only as totals (1,753 MW). IDAE's page cites a networks layer, yet its user manual and viewer code show only demand and waste-heat points. OSM holds 20 tagged pipe ways in Spain. A public register exists only as a draft decree.
main_caveats: The ADHAC list is built from member and public data; the association itself reports gaps ('Opacidad de explotadores', refusals by some companies), so it is a floor, not an official register.
Counts differ: ADHAC 2025 lists 585 networks (Cataluña 246); AVEBIOM 2024 counts 584 biomass networks (Cataluña 278). ADHAC still lists La Valldan (Berga), which AVEBIOM reports removed after a fire.

IDAE's web page says the Mapa de calor includes existing and planned networks, but its 2021 user manual describes only demand and waste-heat points, and its data are estimates 'no pueden considerarse como reales'.

Location is municipality only; rows include single-building systems (hospitals, campuses). Operator figures may be design or phase values (Txantrea: 24,5 MW phase 1 in 2024, 'hasta 39 megavatios' in a 2022 article).
The public national register of urban heating and cooling systems exists only in a draft royal decree (2026 consultation); no approval found as of 2026-11-16.
answer.confidence_reason: Census, AVEBIOM, manual and operator PDFs downloaded and read; viewer live layer and OSM geometry not seen; decree status checked by searches and BOE pages only; operator sample is 8 of 585.

how_to_use.example_result: 19 pages, 309,052 bytes. Rows: 'CATALUÑA | Marina Zona Franca | Barcelona y L'Hospitalet de Llobregat | BARCELONA | CALOR Y FRÍO | BIOMASA / GAS NATURAL / COGENERACIÓN'; 'MADRID | Barajas T4 | Madrid | MADRID | CALOR Y FRÍO | GAS NATURAL'.
steps: Download the PDF and extract with pdftotext -layout; each record starts with a region name at the start of a line and cells wrap onto 1-3 lines.
Count lines that begin with a region name: 585 records (tested), equal to the 585 networks in the 2025 presentation.
Split fuels on ' / ' and treat supply type as CALOR, CALOR Y FRÍO, FRÍO.
Take totals and regional MW from the presentation PDF (10_Presentacion_censo_2025.pdf): 1,753 MW, 1,135 km, 8,094 buildings, 542 heat, 40 heat and cooling, 3 cooling.
Earlier editions use the same columns (2019 PDF checked) so counts can be compared, but renames and merges occur.
reading_traps: No operator, no MW and no coordinates per network: the totals cannot be allocated to rows.
Rows mix city networks with single-building systems (hospitals, shopping centres, campuses, a prison); 'network' means any central plant with a distribution loop.
Region names are inconsistent between rows, and some town names are misspelled ('Aguallana'), so match on province plus name.
The 2025 list still has 'DH P. I. La Valldan' in Berga, which AVEBIOM 2024 reports as destroyed by fire and removed.
ADHAC totals (585 networks, 1,753 MW) and AVEBIOM biomass totals (584 networks, 549 MW) are not comparable; they come from different inventories.

recipe: 1. Start from the ADHAC 2025 PDF (pdftotext -layout) to get the network name, municipality, province, supply type and fuels; 585 rows.

2. For each network of interest, find its operator: search '<network name> red de calor' plus the city council, Somacyl, Districlima/ENGIE or the hospital or campus owner; project pages (EU portal, IDAE RENORED lists) also name beneficiaries.

3. Open the operator's PDF or page and read installed kW, pipe length and diameters (tested on the Somacyl Valladolid Oeste PDF: 6.960 kW, 10.000 m). Check against the AVEBIOM regional table for biomass networks.
4. For the route itself only plans printed as images exist in these documents; render the PDF page with pdftoppm and trace by hand if a drawing is needed.
5. Searches of BOE and regional gazettes for heat-network environmental files returned solar and storage projects only; no heat-network gazette document was found to test (see search log).
